body: Chief: right catch on the delimiter collision; approved with one adjustment — do not make it a String. Add an opaque PolicyModelIdentity (private constructor, derived only from EmbedderInfo: name + version, length-delimited canonical render for the wire/receipt) and have RemotePolicy.allowedModels and RemoteCapability.model take that type; callers cannot format or forge it. Laws: the adversarial collision pair (name='a@b', version='c') vs (name='a', version='b@c') yields distinct identities; render/parse fixed point; identity changes when version changes. One ADR 0001 D6 sentence names it (paragraph-disjoint edit rule applies).
